nom: First Aid Beauty Ultra Repair Hydrating Pillow Pads with Colloidal Oatmeal + Ceramides

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are divided: many report zero irritation and soothing relief, including for eczema and rosacea, but a smaller group describes itching, redness, or burning, with one reviewer linking the reaction to the propolis in the formula.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or chronically dry skin, especially in winter, widely report the pads deliver a noticeable moisture boost and help dry patches, though a few say the hydration is superficial and dryness returns within hours.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including one who leans sensitive and dry on the T-zone, report the pads hydrate without adding oiliness and feel gentle enough for regular use.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe a genuine hydration boost, with skin feeling soft, plump, and less tight afterward, though several early critical reviews found the pads underwhelming, with one reporting zero hydration and others saying a single pad isn't saturated enough on its own.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report mixed effects on redness: several say the pads calm redness and puffiness, but others report the pads themselves triggered new redness, stinging, or itchy patches, particularly on sensitive skin.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers credit the pads with supporting or repairing their moisture barrier without stripping the skin, though this is reported by a minority.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report fewer breakouts or clearer skin after incorporating the pads, including for post-workout and hormonal breakouts, with no reviewer reporting the pads caused new blemishes.

aspects.libelle: Pads not saturated enough for some users
Airtight packaging keeps pads from drying out
Can be hard to peel apart
Large pad count offers good value and longevity

extraits.texte: Beware if you have sensitive skin. I used these twice and both times my skin became very itchy with noticeable red splotches. They contain propolis, which may be triggering the reaction. Unfortunately, I didn't find them moisturizing or soothing at all. My skin felt more irritated than hydrated. This is not what I expected from First Aid Beauty. I have used their face wash for a decade, and now I'm nervous that their formula may have changed along with the packaging…

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was excited to try a product from First Aid Beauty for the first time, but unfortunately the ultra repair hydrating pillow pads didn't work well for me. I have dry, acne-prone skin and I swiped a pad over my face before bed. The pads aren't as soft as I hoped, and the formula felt too lightweight, like I was just applying water on my face. It didn't feel like my face was any more hydrated than before. I also experienced some mild stinging/burning when applying the product. There is a light scent, but it's not irritating. The next morning, I noticed small, new pimples. I skipped the product for a few days and tried again to see if my skin reacts differently. Once again, I had a new pimple after using this product before going to bed. That said, I've had other family members try them, both younger (with acne) and older (sensitive skin, rosacea) and they both liked the pillow pads for hydration and soothing skin. This product might work well for others, just wasn't a good fit for me.

I never write reviews but just had to for tbis product. I suffer from very dry and very red skin in the winter time and it is basically impossible for me to control it. I went into Ulta and asked the sales person what they would recommend for somebody with sensitive dry skin and she immediately showed me this product. I'm usually wary of anything that is in a cotton pad form because in the past, they have been prone to dry my skin out, but these keep my skin, plump, moisturized, and glowy. I use one pad all over my face in the morning after cleansing before the rest of my skin care and it is definitely going to be a permanent fixture in my skin care routine all year round.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using these pads for about two weeks now, and they've quickly become a staple in my skincare routine. As someone with combination skin that leans sensitive, I'm always cautious about adding exfoliating products, but these pads have been remarkably gentle yet effective. The texture of these pads is wonderfully soft—they really do feel like tiny pillows against your skin. They're generously saturated without being dripping wet. After using them, my skin feels noticeably smoother and more hydrated rather than stripped or tight. The colloidal oatmeal and hyaluronic acid in the formula seem to balance out the exfoliating acids perfectly, leaving my skin calm and plump. If you've been hesitant to try chemical exfoliation or have struggled with harsh toners in the past, these pillow pads are an excellent introduction. They're proof that effective exfoliation doesn't have to come with redness or irritation. The quality and gentleness make them worth it for anyone seeking smoother, brighter skin without the drama.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have dry skin and tend to get dry spots in between my eyebrows so these are great to add some extra hydration and I can set it on my dry patches to give it the hydration it needs. These help my makeup apply so much better because my skin is extra hydrated and it absorbs quickly! It doesn't have a strong scent and didn't make me breakout or get any redness.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm very happy with these pads for my face. My skin is dry and sensitive, and they provide quick relief, drying almost instantly and giving me wonderful comfort. The ingredients hydrate and cleanse, helping my skin barrier. It's a product I would gladly pay for. I received it for free in exchange for my honest opinion.
